en:
Kaede! I have a problem!
A super-duper serious problem!
Wh-What happened!?

Atua demands that we do a paint-and-piano
jam session!
Huh...?

We must fuse your piano playing with my
painting! Nyahahaha! This will be so divine!

Sorry, but I don't know how you can fuse music
and painting together. I can't picture it.
I dunno either!
But you're the one who suggested it.

It'll be fine. Atua will fill me with divine
inspiration and show us the way.
C'mon, let's do it! Let's do it!

Atua says we gotta do it or He'll pour His
wrath upon us, y'know?
<CLT=cltMIND>I doubt Atua said that...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm pretty sure it's all Angie talking.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe she's actually lonely...
Yeah, sure... Let's do it.
Yay! We're gonna do do do it!

<CLT=cltMIND>First, I'll have Angie listen to me play the piano,
but...
Angie, do you have any songs you wanna hear?
I will welcome any song you choose.

Oh, but...I think I'd like a song that will make
me feel...divine while I'm listening to it.
That's a...difficult request...

<CLT=cltMIND>Divine...divine... Hmmm, I guess it should be fine
as long as I make it fun.
<CLT=cltMIND>I got it! Yeah, I'll do *that* song!
Then, I'll begin.
Okay!

<CLT=cltMIND>I sat down, straightened my back, and placed my
fingers on the cold, smooth keys of the piano.

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes...I feel like I could play like
this forever!

<CLT=cltMIND>No matter where I am, the piano will always be
there for me...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can feel my <CLT=cltSTRONG>partner<CLT=cltMIND>'s passion—the same feeling
I had when we first started walking together!
Alright, here I go!
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...

Well, how was it, Angie?
This song...
Huh!?
Zzzzz...zzzzz...
She's sleeping!?
Zzzzz...zzzzz...zzzzz...zzzzz...

<CLT=cltMIND>Geez, she fell asleep even though she asked
me to play. And it was a really lively song, too.
Ngh, grgh...zzzzz...zzzzz...

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie...scares me sometimes, but she
looks like an angel right now.
Hmmmm...
Oh, are you awake?

Wednesday morning... Need sacrifice...
Hurry... Can't wait...
What?

Not enough blood... Need more blood...
So I'll... I'll...

Hahhh! Stop!
Ngh, ergh... Ngahhhh... It's too much!

Is she having a nightmare!?
Angie, wake up! I said, wake up!
Huh?
Oh, hi Kaede. Was I sleeping?

Sorry 'bout that. But thanks to your piano,
I got to have a wonderful dream.

Are you sure about that...? You sounded pretty
distressed...

Hehe, Atua says He was so enchanted by you, He
accidentally poured His divine wrath somewhere.

He poured it!? Where!? Divine wrath shouldn't
just be accidentally poured somewhere, right!?

I'm starting to like your music, Kaede! Let's
have a paint-and-piano jam session very soon!
O-Okay...

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I guess it wouldn't be so bad to get
along with Angie...

<CLT=cltMIND>We might even be able to exchange artistic ideas
with each other.
<CLT=cltMIND>Although, I'd never accept Atua...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Angie's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Angie, I returned
to my room.
